work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

collection_state.note: Pass 41 was discovered while pass 40 had an active independent PR. Raw evidence and this handoff were prepared without touching generated registry views; admission/registry validation remains pending until the shared registry surface is free.

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission preparation for the corrected 171-trial corpus only. Earlier contaminated Claude Code, OpenCode diagnostic, and Pi shared-skill/OAuth runs remain source provenance but are not promoted into the candidate batch.
discovery_pass.environment: host-based execution without Docker; isolated per-trial workspaces adapted from Terminal-Bench task inputs; each task scored by its own hidden test suite

source_known_dimensions: three repetitions per task and harness
same source-intended Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 model family
same host-based runner and hidden-test success semantics
operator-specific harness configuration was actively isolated before corrected trials
all three source aggregates report 50 successes from 57 trials
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: Claude Code and Pi use the bare source model label claude-sonnet-5 while OpenCode uses anthropic/claude-sonnet-5
exact service-side model revision identity is not independently proven by W1
historical CLI versions are not recovered
Claude Code used Pro/Max subscription OAuth while Pi and OpenCode used Anthropic Console API keys
temperature or equivalent sampling control is not uniformly exposed across harnesses
host execution adapts Terminal-Bench absolute /app paths rather than reproducing the original Docker lane

provenance_strength.w1_treatment: preserve corrected source aggregates and correction provenance without importing superseded runs or evaluative ranking language

protocol_deviations_and_failures.detail: The source discovered operator-environment contamination in Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi at different stages. Corrected trials were rerun and the superseded trial sets were archived rather than overwritten. W1 admits only the final corrected runs/ corpus.

Claude Code used a Pro/Max subscription OAuth path while Pi and OpenCode used Anthropic Console API keys. The source accepts this as a permanent confound; W1 preserves it without adjudicating matched-cell eligibility.
The source ran on the host without Docker and substituted Terminal-Bench hardcoded /app paths into per-trial workspaces and scoring copies.
The source identifies the 19-task study as a pilot and states that its own power calculation requires roughly 28-30 tasks for a defensible non-inferiority claim. W1 does not promote such a claim.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: runs-pilot1-contaminated and other superseded diagnostic/contaminated corpora
non_admission_dispositions.reason: The source explicitly supersedes these runs after discovering operator-environment or credential contamination. They remain provenance only.
W1 stores the reported relative geometric-mean token metrics but does not declare a winner or generalize beyond the bounded source conditions.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: non-inferiority or equality conclusion from identical aggregate success rates
non_admission_dispositions.reason: The source itself states the pilot is under the task count required by its planned non-inferiority analysis.

validation.pending_reason: Pass 40 PR #137 currently owns the generated registry surface. Pass 41 has not yet run admission or regenerated registry views.
